2025-11-28T10:44:42.403415447Z {"timestamp":"2025-11-28T10:44:42.403256Z","level":"DEBUG","fields":{"summary":"SELECT s.id, s.is_active, s.created_at, …","db.statement":"\n\n\n                    SELECT \n                        s.id,\n                        s.is_active,\n                        s.created_at,\n                        s.category,\n                        -- Extraire titre_service (support des deux formats)\n                        COALESCE(\n                            s.data->>'titre_service',\n                            s.data->'titre_service'->>'valeur',\n                            s.data->>'titre',\n                            'Service sans titre'\n                        ) as titre_service,\n                        -- Extraire description (tronquée à 200 caractères pour la liste)\n                        LEFT(\n                            COALESCE(\n                                s.data->>'description',\n                                s.data->'description'->>'valeur',\n                                ''\n                            ),\n                            200\n                        ) as description_preview,\n                        -- ✅ CORRIGÉ 2025-11-28: Afficher TOUS les produits (actifs ET désactivés) pour la page de management\n                        -- Le champ is_active est inclus pour que le frontend puisse afficher un indicateur visuel\n                        -- Page de management = prestataire doit voir tous ses produits pour les gérer\n                        COALESCE(\n                            (\n                                SELECT jsonb_agg(\n                                    jsonb_build_object(\n                                        'nom', COALESCE(p.product->>'nom', p.product->>'name', p.product->>'titre', ''),\n                                        'prix', p.product->>'prix',\n                                        'devise', p.product->>'devise',\n                                        'is_active', COALESCE(pl.is_active, true)  -- ✅ Inclure is_active pour indicateur visuel\n                                    )\n                                    ORDER BY p.idx\n                                )\n                                FROM LATERAL jsonb_array_elements(\n                                    CASE \n                                        WHEN jsonb_typeof(s.data->'produits') = 'array' THEN s.data->'produits'\n                                        WHEN jsonb_typeof(s.data->'produits'->'valeur') = 'array' THEN s.data->'produits'->'valeur'\n                                        ELSE '[]'::jsonb\n                                    END\n                                ) WITH ORDINALITY AS p(product, idx)\n                                LEFT JOIN products_lifecycle pl \n                                    ON pl.service_id = s.id AND pl.product_index = p.idx - 1\n                                -- ✅ Pas de filtre WHERE : afficher TOUS les produits pour management\n                            ),\n                            '[]'::jsonb\n                        ) as produits_light,\n                        -- ✅ CORRIGÉ 2025-11-28: Compter TOUS les produits (actifs ET désactivés) pour la page de management\n                        -- Le prestataire doit voir le nombre total de produits qu'il a créés\n                        COALESCE(\n                            jsonb_array_length(\n                                CASE \n                                    WHEN jsonb_typeof(s.data->'produits') = 'array' THEN s.data->'produits'\n                                    WHEN jsonb_typeof(s.data->'produits'->'valeur') = 'array' THEN s.data->'produits'->'valeur'\n                                    ELSE '[]'::jsonb\n                                END\n                            )::BIGINT,\n                            0\n                        ) as produits_count,\n                        -- Garder seulement le place_id de Google Places\n                        s.data->'google_place'->>'place_id' as google_place_id\n                    FROM services s\n                    WHERE s.user_id = $1\n                    ORDER BY s.created_at DESC\n                    LIMIT $2 OFFSET $3\n                    \n","rows_affected":1,"rows_returned":1,"elapsed":"42.95239ms","elapsed_secs":0.04295239},"target":"sqlx::query"}

2025-11-28T10:44:56.605809966Z {"timestamp":"2025-11-28T10:44:56.605738Z","level":"DEBUG","fields":{"summary":"WITH reservations AS ( …","db.statement":"\n\n\n            WITH reservations AS (\n                SELECT flash_sale_id, SUM(quantity) AS reserved_quantity\n                FROM live_flash_sale_reservations\n                GROUP BY flash_sale_id\n            )\n            SELECT\n                lfs.id,\n                lfs.live_session_id,\n                lfs.service_id,\n                lfs.stock_target,\n                COALESCE(res.reserved_quantity, 0) AS reserved_quantity,\n                lfs.commentary_interval_seconds,\n                lfs.last_commentary_sent_at,\n                lfs.end_at,\n                COALESCE(lfs.metadata, '{}'::jsonb) AS flash_metadata,\n                ls.host_user_id,\n                ls.service_id AS primary_service_id,\n                COALESCE(ls.metadata, '{}'::jsonb) AS session_metadata,\n                ls.title\n            FROM live_flash_sales lfs\n            JOIN live_sessions ls ON ls.id = lfs.live_session_id\n            LEFT JOIN reservations res ON res.flash_sale_id = lfs.id\n            WHERE lfs.status = 'live'\n              AND lfs.commentary_mode = 'ai_voice'\n              AND lfs.end_at > $1\n              AND (\n                    lfs.last_commentary_sent_at IS NULL\n                    OR lfs.last_commentary_sent_at <= $1 - make_interval(secs => lfs.commentary_interval_seconds)\n              )\n            \n","rows_affected":0,"rows_returned":0,"elapsed":"909.081µs","elapsed_secs":0.000909081},"target":"sqlx::query"}
2025-11-28T10:44:56.60730108Z {"timestamp":"2025-11-28T10:44:56.607230Z","level":"DEBUG","fields":{"summary":"UPDATE live_flash_sales SET status …","db.statement":"\n\nUPDATE live_flash_sales SET status = 'ended', updated_at = NOW() WHERE status IN ('scheduled', 'live') AND end_at <= $1\n","rows_affected":0,"rows_returned":0,"elapsed":"758.567µs","elapsed_secs":0.000758567},"target":"sqlx::query"}
2025-11-28T10:44:56.775206453Z {"timestamp":"2025-11-28T10:44:56.775093Z","level":"DEBUG","fields":{"summary":"SELECT id, delivery_id, zone_id, …","db.statement":"\n\n\n            SELECT\n                id,\n                delivery_id,\n                zone_id,\n                status,\n                priority,\n                attempt_count,\n                payload,\n                next_attempt_at,\n                enqueued_at,\n                updated_at\n            FROM delivery_matching_queue\n            WHERE status IN ('queued', 'searching')\n              AND next_attempt_at <= NOW()\n            ORDER BY priority ASC, next_attempt_at ASC\n            LIMIT $1\n            \n","rows_affected":0,"rows_returned":0,"elapsed":"860.31µs","elapsed_secs":0.00086031},"target":"sqlx::query"}

2025-11-28T10:45:26.608720818Z {"timestamp":"2025-11-28T10:45:26.608637Z","level":"DEBUG","fields":{"summary":"WITH reservations AS ( …","db.statement":"\n\n\n            WITH reservations AS (\n                SELECT flash_sale_id, SUM(quantity) AS reserved_quantity\n                FROM live_flash_sale_reservations\n                GROUP BY flash_sale_id\n            )\n            SELECT\n                lfs.id,\n                lfs.live_session_id,\n                lfs.service_id,\n                lfs.stock_target,\n                COALESCE(res.reserved_quantity, 0) AS reserved_quantity,\n                lfs.commentary_interval_seconds,\n                lfs.last_commentary_sent_at,\n                lfs.end_at,\n                COALESCE(lfs.metadata, '{}'::jsonb) AS flash_metadata,\n                ls.host_user_id,\n                ls.service_id AS primary_service_id,\n                COALESCE(ls.metadata, '{}'::jsonb) AS session_metadata,\n                ls.title\n            FROM live_flash_sales lfs\n            JOIN live_sessions ls ON ls.id = lfs.live_session_id\n            LEFT JOIN reservations res ON res.flash_sale_id = lfs.id\n            WHERE lfs.status = 'live'\n              AND lfs.commentary_mode = 'ai_voice'\n              AND lfs.end_at > $1\n              AND (\n                    lfs.last_commentary_sent_at IS NULL\n                    OR lfs.last_commentary_sent_at <= $1 - make_interval(secs => lfs.commentary_interval_seconds)\n              )\n            \n","rows_affected":0,"rows_returned":0,"elapsed":"2.705272ms","elapsed_secs":0.002705272},"target":"sqlx::query"}

2025-11-28T10:47:56.606672858Z {"timestamp":"2025-11-28T10:47:56.606591Z","level":"DEBUG","fields":{"summary":"WITH reservations AS ( …","db.statement":"\n\n\n            WITH reservations AS (\n                SELECT flash_sale_id, SUM(quantity) AS reserved_quantity\n                FROM live_flash_sale_reservations\n                GROUP BY flash_sale_id\n            )\n            SELECT\n                lfs.id,\n                lfs.live_session_id,\n                lfs.service_id,\n                lfs.stock_target,\n                COALESCE(res.reserved_quantity, 0) AS reserved_quantity,\n                lfs.commentary_interval_seconds,\n                lfs.last_commentary_sent_at,\n                lfs.end_at,\n                COALESCE(lfs.metadata, '{}'::jsonb) AS flash_metadata,\n                ls.host_user_id,\n                ls.service_id AS primary_service_id,\n                COALESCE(ls.metadata, '{}'::jsonb) AS session_metadata,\n                ls.title\n            FROM live_flash_sales lfs\n            JOIN live_sessions ls ON ls.id = lfs.live_session_id\n            LEFT JOIN reservations res ON res.flash_sale_id = lfs.id\n            WHERE lfs.status = 'live'\n              AND lfs.commentary_mode = 'ai_voice'\n              AND lfs.end_at > $1\n              AND (\n                    lfs.last_commentary_sent_at IS NULL\n                    OR lfs.last_commentary_sent_at <= $1 - make_interval(secs => lfs.commentary_interval_seconds)\n              )\n            \n","rows_affected":0,"rows_returned":0,"elapsed":"989.263µs","elapsed_secs":0.000989263},"target":"sqlx::query"}

2025-11-28T10:48:26.605243218Z {"timestamp":"2025-11-28T10:48:26.605182Z","level":"DEBUG","fields":{"summary":"WITH reservations AS ( …","db.statement":"\n\n\n            WITH reservations AS (\n                SELECT flash_sale_id, SUM(quantity) AS reserved_quantity\n                FROM live_flash_sale_reservations\n                GROUP BY flash_sale_id\n            )\n            SELECT\n                lfs.id,\n                lfs.live_session_id,\n                lfs.service_id,\n                lfs.stock_target,\n                COALESCE(res.reserved_quantity, 0) AS reserved_quantity,\n                lfs.commentary_interval_seconds,\n                lfs.last_commentary_sent_at,\n                lfs.end_at,\n                COALESCE(lfs.metadata, '{}'::jsonb) AS flash_metadata,\n                ls.host_user_id,\n                ls.service_id AS primary_service_id,\n                COALESCE(ls.metadata, '{}'::jsonb) AS session_metadata,\n                ls.title\n            FROM live_flash_sales lfs\n            JOIN live_sessions ls ON ls.id = lfs.live_session_id\n            LEFT JOIN reservations res ON res.flash_sale_id = lfs.id\n            WHERE lfs.status = 'live'\n              AND lfs.commentary_mode = 'ai_voice'\n              AND lfs.end_at > $1\n              AND (\n                    lfs.last_commentary_sent_at IS NULL\n                    OR lfs.last_commentary_sent_at <= $1 - make_interval(secs => lfs.commentary_interval_seconds)\n              )\n            \n","rows_affected":0,"rows_returned":0,"elapsed":"1.144656ms","elapsed_secs":0.001144656},"target":"sqlx::query"}
